title: What is ScrollView?
overview: ScrollView is a React Native component that allows users to scroll through content when the content size is larger than the screen. It can contain multiple components and supports both vertical and horizontal scrolling.

title: ScrollView Properties
overview: ScrollView provides different properties to control scrolling behavior, direction, indicators, and content appearance.

title: What is FlatList?
overview: FlatList is a React Native component used to efficiently render large lists of data. Unlike ScrollView, FlatList only renders items currently visible on the screen, improving performance.

example.title: Basic FlatList Example

title: FlatList Important Props
overview: FlatList uses different props to display and manage list data. These props define the data source, rendering method, keys, and list behavior.

example.title: FlatList Props
example.content:
data
renderItem
keyExtractor
ListHeaderComponent
ListFooterComponent
ItemSeparatorComponent

title: Rendering Custom List Items
overview: FlatList allows developers to create reusable components for each list item. This keeps code organized and makes complex lists easier to maintain.

title: FlatList Performance Optimization
overview: FlatList provides optimization features to handle large datasets efficiently. Proper configuration helps reduce memory usage and improves application performance.

title: ScrollView vs FlatList
overview: ScrollView and FlatList are both used for displaying scrollable content, but they are designed for different use cases. ScrollView is suitable for small content while FlatList is better for large lists.

example.title: Comparison
example.content:
ScrollView:
• Renders all items at once.
• Used for small content.

FlatList:
• Renders visible items only.
• Used for large datasets.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how ScrollView works, how to use FlatList for optimized lists, important FlatList properties, custom rendering, performance optimization, and the difference between ScrollView and FlatList.
